notes: Source: 2026 Arizona Cardinals Media Guide, 'RECORDS' appendix pp. 218-224 (PDF page = printed page number). Each category is a box 'INDIVIDUAL ... RECORDS' with Career / Season / Game sub-lists; every list here is ranked by exactly the stat, so all kind=list.

through_season 2025: the lists include 2025-season entries (Trey McBride 2025 season receptions, Jacoby Brissett/Michael Wilson games of Nov. 16, 2025, Kyler Murray career 2019-25) and the guide has 2025 final statistics/game summaries (pp. 179-203).
The guide prints no rank numbers; ranks here follow printed order (best first) and tied values share the lowest rank (competition ranking, e.g. 1,1,1,4,4); tie=true marks every tied row.

Career rows are the whole printed list when 10 or fewer were printed; season and game lists transcribe about the top 5 ranks (full tie groups at the boundary are not always copied; complete_to is the number of rows the guide prints and scope_note says what was copied).

Game-list 'years' are the printed game dates reformatted to MM/DD/YYYY; the opponent and extra stats stay in raw. A career span such as '2021-' (James Conner) is printed that way for a player still active in 2026.

Franchise history includes pre-NFL-era-merger and 1920s entries (Ernie Nevers 1929, Paddy Driscoll 1923) exactly as printed. Rows marked '*' on the 6-TD rush, 5-TD receiving and 4-INT games are the guide's 'equals/ties NFL record' flags, still club rows.
Season rec_td rows that share one printed line (e.g. '14 ... Roy Green, 1983; Mal Kutner, 1948') repeat the whole printed line in raw.
Tackles: no list exists in this guide for any scope, so those three pairs are 'missing'.
